column3: “Haters … lovers … tearers” are rendered “You who hate … love … tear off.”
“Just as in the pot” is rendered “as for the pot,” and “caldron” “kettle.”
“Made their deeds evil” is rendered “practiced evil deeds”; NASB adds “Instead.”
“Who bite with their teeth” is rendered “When they have something to bite with their teeth,” and “consecrate war” “declare holy war.”
“From vision … from divining” is rendered “without vision … without divination”; “will go” is rendered “will go down.”
“Abashed” is rendered “embarrassed”; “cover over a moustache” is rendered “cover their mouths.”
“Spirit” is capitalized; “might” is rendered “courage,” and “transgression” “rebellious act.”
“Chiefs” is rendered “leaders”; “they judge” is rendered “pronounce judgment,” and “depend” “lean.”
“Mountain of the house” is rendered “mountain of the temple.”
